stories.headline: Colombian police report a 7.6-tonne cocaine load blended with powdered panela at Cartagena, the port's biggest haul in a decade
stories.summary: The national police anti-narcotics directorate, working under its Esmeralda strategy, found the shipment at the Cartagena port; the cocaine had been mixed into powdered panela…
